notes.title: Strike Master Apocalypse Patch Notes/Updates
notes.content:
While I have not changed much in the actual vanilla game itself, I have fixed a major problem in the DLC. So recently I checked up on the game, since I have not in a while, and in one of the levels the player was stuck in the ground, and this prevented anyone from moving forward. So after tinkering around a little it has been fixed, and now you can complete the DLC with no error :) And sorry I have not kept your guys updated on what is going on in a while. But some cool things are coming up :) Especially since now I am stuck inside everyday, I can get patches/announcements out faster. 

https://66.media.tumblr.com/a6f9d2a65a25714ae75bae7a91ec339b/tumblr_mt11n2p1ok1svakfso1_500.gif

notes.title: New Game Update
notes.content: Hello everyone, recently over the last few weeks I have been working on some pretty big, a new update for Strike Master Apocalypse. However this is not just any normal update or bug patch. No. This is an update that expands the story. So what that means it that, when the update goes live you can access a new DLC through the main menu called "The Rise Of Evil" which takes you to the past where you play a different character that's not Bluey, but instead a female protagonists, who wants to discover the secrets of her past. So you can explore 3 whole new levels including, all new bosses, NPC's, and new enemy variations. But that is not all. Also with this new update, a new game mode is added called, Clash. In Clash you and a friend fight each other to the death in an arena. And while right now there is only one version of Clash, many more game play styles and game modes will be added later along the line, through free updates. So to everyone who sees this post and downloads the new update in a little bit, I wish you good luck for the journey that you will take part of, but most of all, have fun. ːsteamhappyː ːsteamhappyː
